verses.1: They will be separated from the desert and the valley. A storm will be revealed, and they will bloom like flowers.
verses.2: It will bloom and reveal its beauty. Even the smallest flowers will be admired for their beauty. The vineyard and the olive trees will be honored by God. They will be praised by our God.
verses.3: Strengthen your weak hands and your broken feet. May they be healed.
verses.4: Say to those who are afraid: “Be strong! Do not be afraid. Look, your God will bring retribution. The throne of God will come, and He will save you.”
verses.5: Then, the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be tuned.
verses.6: Then it will rain like hail, and the land will be covered with water and rivers in the wilderness.
verses.7: And it will become a place of rest for the waters, and a refuge for those who seek shelter from the stormy waves. It will also be a place for hunting and gathering.
verses.8: And there shall be a path and a road, a holy path. No unclean person shall pass along it. He who walks along this path will not be harmed.
verses.9: There shall be no lions or wild animals there. No one will find any living creatures there. And they will go away in fear.
verses.10: And the blessings of Jehovah will be upon them. They will come in triumph, filled with eternal joy. They will enjoy great happiness and joy.
